sections.what_is_the_linear_morphea:
Linear morphea is a type of morphea which is usually found on the legs or arms and appears as a single band of thick and there is discoloration of the skin. These may extend up to the tissues under the skin as well as muscles which lead to deformities. 
 As per Ayurveda Aspect :- 
 Linear morphea is not properly mentioned in Ayurveda. But as this disease is caused due to the weak immunity so in Ayurveda it can be correlated to vyadhi kshamatav (in which the body is unable to prevent the infections.) This is made up to two words vyadhi and kshamatav in which vyadhi means that the body is suffering from any physical or mental disease which means the basic elements of the body are vitiated. Kshmatav refers to the protection of the body from various infections. 
 As per Modern Aspect :- 
 Autoimmune diseases occur when the immune system that protects the body from bacteria, fungi, and virus mistakenly attacks an individual’s body. These lesions have 5 main presenting features :- 

 Linear (lines involved on the hands or limbs) 
 Generalized (circles on the limbs and trunk) 
 Circumscribed (Few circles present on the limbs or trunk) 
 Mixed (Combination of all the features) 
 Pansclerotic (In this there is skin involvement) 

 These are usually limited to the skin but sometimes may extend to deeper muscles or bones. It may also involve inside of the mouth, eyes, and genitals.
